items.text: 模型选择统一为家族、运行模式与支持平台，按精确模型契约展示和校验参数。
items.text_en: Model selection groups families, run modes and supported providers, with parameters displayed and validated against exact model contracts.

items.text: 画布创作输入支持 Enter 运行或保存、Shift+Enter 换行，并保护输入法确认与忙碌状态。
items.text_en: Canvas creation inputs support Enter to run or save and Shift+Enter for new lines, with IME and busy-state protection.

items.text: Hypit 按生成用途选择模型，任务参数按请求校验，候选过滤区分语音、音效与音乐。
items.text_en: Hypit selects models by generation purpose, validates task parameters per request and distinguishes speech, sound effects and music.

items.text: 完善模型身份归类、候选投影、请求幂等和参数契约回归，保留用户配置与模型真实 ID。
items.text_en: Improve model identity classification, candidate projection, request idempotency and parameter contract regression while preserving user settings and real model IDs.
